job.title: Associate Data Scientist (Tabular & Predictive ML)
job.description: CreditPulse (Gurugram) builds algorithmic risk scoring for consumer lending. We seek an Associate Data Scientist with strong background in statistical modeling, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, and feature engineering on large tabular datasets.

pool.text: Supervised Learning Algorithms: in-depth mastery of Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Logistic Regression
Feature Engineering: handled missing data imputation, target encoding, outlier detection, and scaling
Model Interpretability (SHAP & LIME): explained feature importances and individual prediction drivers
Cross-Validation & Hyperopt: tuned hyperparameters using Optuna with stratified K-fold validation
DefaultGuard: loan default risk scoring pipeline with 0.84 ROC-AUC on simulated credit dataset
B.Stat / B.Tech Data Science, ISI Kolkata / BITS Pilani, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.7/10
Pandas & Polars: processed 5M+ row datasets efficiently with parallelised queries
Swift iOS development: built a stopwatch application in Xcode
Data Science Intern at FinRisk Labs (Gurugram, 4 months): developed churn prediction model
SQL for Analytics: wrote window functions, rank queries, and cohorts in Snowflake / Postgres
Unity 3D game engine: created 2D platformer game as hobby
Model Evaluation Metrics: analyzed ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, confusion matrix, precision, and recall trade-offs
